agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has large dt=0.0194 (near max) and sensor_noise=0.0145 with no pushes. Controller acts once per outer step on noisy angle measurement; the noise plus coarse discretization destabilizes the state-feedback loop. Trace shows pole error grows monotonically from near-upright (~0.03 rad at step 30) to violation: theta -0.203 at step31, -0.400 at step32, -0.619 at step33, -0.852 at step34 (>0.8). Zeroing sensor_noise alone (counterfactual) stabilizes the same plant/dt and eliminates violation, confirming noise-induced loss of pole upright with this dt/controller timing is the cause.
